scripts.speaker: Old Man
scripts.text: Eh! Can't and old man walk in peace anymore?!

scripts.speaker: Old Man
scripts.text:
Eh? whats that?!
 
My wife wants me home?! Alright, alright... I'm going, I'm going. Thank you for telling me the message.
 
Here take this Treasure Token.

scripts.speaker: Kieth
scripts.text: Sorry can't talk, I'm a busy man, I'm waiting for my package.

scripts.speaker: Kieth
scripts.text: Weren't you supposed to deliver me a box? Where is it?

scripts.speaker: Kieth
scripts.text:
Ahh, you must be from the Treasure Hunter Agency. Do you have my bow??
 
Ahh, good,thank you for your time. Take this Treasure Token.

scripts.speaker: Billy-Bob
scripts.text: Arrrg!... Those Bastard Bugs have eaten everything, this place doesn't even look like my farm anymore!!

scripts.speaker: Billy-Bob
scripts.text:
Ohhh, thank you thats a good start for me.
Well those bugs can bugger off...
 
Well here take these 2 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Billy-Bob
scripts.text:
Those Bastard Bugs are Everywhere!!!
You must be from the guild! OK, bring me 20 Worm Peelings, 20 Jellopies, 20 fluff and 20 Clovers.

scripts.speaker: Old Lady
scripts.text: This is my husbands grave... I'm just paying him a little visit.

scripts.speaker: Old Lady
scripts.text: You have them?!

scripts.speaker: Old Lady
scripts.text: Thank you sooo much here have these 3 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Old Lady
scripts.text:
So your the one that has come to help me?
 
Ok well this is what I wanted you to do, this greave beside me is my husbands grave and I promised him that I would bury some Mementos with him, The problem is that I have no Mementos...

scripts.speaker: Old Lady
scripts.text: Bring me 15 Mementos, please.

scripts.speaker: Erika
scripts.text: Hello my name is Erika.

scripts.speaker: Erika
scripts.text:
What's that? You have a letter for me!!
Oooooh I just love,love letters :D. next here will I open it.

scripts.speaker: Letter
scripts.text:
Dear Erika
 
Sorry to inform you but you have been evicted, please move out within 3-5 days.
 
-Management

scripts.speaker: Erika
scripts.text:
Oh... um... Well fuck, that bastard thinks he can kick me out!!!!! He's got another thing coming!
 
Well thank you for delivering this anyway have this Treasure Token.

scripts.speaker: Erika
scripts.text:
So your the one that has a letter for me?
 
Ok well where's the letter?

scripts.speaker: Jeramiah
scripts.text: Its so boring when you have to next on people...

scripts.speaker: Jeramiah
scripts.text:
Ahh hello, you must be from the Treasure Hunter Guild.
Do you have my Jur? Ahh good good. Thank you.
Here have this Treasure Hunter Token.

scripts.speaker: Jeramiah
scripts.text:
So your the one that is supposed to bring my Jur?
So where's my Jur?

scripts.speaker: Lenith
scripts.text: Hello, sorry I don't have much time to talk I'm waiting for someone.

scripts.speaker: Lenith
scripts.text:
Oh hello, OH you have my honey, my bees and I thank you.
 
Here have these 2 Treasure Hunter Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Lenith
scripts.text:
Hello, my name is Lenith and I have a quest for you.
Well recently a bunch of stupid bears stole the supers off all my bee's nests...Stupid bears.
 
What I need you to do is find me some more honey so these bee's can get through the winter. I will need about 20 Honey.

scripts.speaker: Molly
scripts.text: Sorry can't talk, I'm waiting for someone.

scripts.speaker: Molly
scripts.text:
WOW YOU DID IT!!!
 
I knew you looked strong, I have no idea how you could have killed that monster though.
thank you so much, here have these 3 Guild Tokens as a reward.

scripts.speaker: Molly
scripts.text:
Wow you must be the brave man from the treasure hunter guild!
Ok here is whats happening, I don't know what started it but there is a strange Ronan Skeleton running around the woods 2 East from here.

scripts.speaker: Molly
scripts.text:
We have try to kill him in the past but it was not...ummm...It was a bad idea. What I want you to do is go there and bring me back his Skull as proof of you killing him.
 
Good Luck

scripts.speaker: Clark
scripts.text: Love to chat, but I'm waiting for someone.

scripts.speaker: Clark
scripts.text:
Ok well this is a start.
 
I hope that this hole will go away 1 day, and I might have another quest for you in the future.
here take these 2 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Clark
scripts.text:
Well hello to you.
You must be from the Treasure Hunter Guild.
 
Ok well this is my problem, yah see that hole in the ground? Yah that thing just popped out of nowhere a couple years ago, inside its full of these ugly ants and these monsters called Giearths.

scripts.speaker: Clark
scripts.text: What I want you to do is kill some of the Giearths.Bring me 30 of there little Moustaches.

scripts.speaker: Flank
scripts.text: Sorry I'm waiting for my package so I don't want to talk.

scripts.speaker: Flank
scripts.text: Perfect right on time, now I must be going to plant this bomb.... Err I mean give this package to my mother for her birthday.

scripts.speaker: Flank
scripts.text:
Thanks
Have this Treasure Token

scripts.speaker: Flank
scripts.text:
So you have my packages?
Well where is it then?

scripts.speaker: Sewer Management
scripts.text: Live doesn't get any worse for me, working in this bug filled Culvert every day...

scripts.speaker: Sewer Management
scripts.text:
Well that looked like it was no trouble for you.
Thanks have these 4 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Sewer Management
scripts.text:
For a while now we have had monster, mostly bugs infesting the culvert...
 
What I want you to do is kinda clean some of it out, every little bit counts.
Bring me 150 Worm Peelings.

scripts.speaker: Rudolfo
scripts.text: Danger, the Coal Mine is now a hostile area.

scripts.speaker: Rudolfo
scripts.text:
Well its good to see that you have come back alive.
I had my doubts but thank you for your help.
 
Here have these 4 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Rudolfo
scripts.text:
Hello, you must be from the Treasure Hunter Guild.
 
They must have filled you in on what is happening on the lower levels of this Coal Mine, I know its disturbing and we are still trying to figure out why and how 2 Evil Druids got down there.
 
Well what I want you to do is bring me 50 Lantern's as proof that you have cleaned some of them out, any loot you find down there you may keep other then what I have asked you to get for me.

scripts.speaker: Flora
scripts.text: Well hello be careful in the cave, we have heard reports of Undead monster funning around.

scripts.speaker: Flora
scripts.text:
Welcome back, good job you did it. (I wonder if that Flaming Bastard is still alive)
Well I hope that cut down a bit on the monsters and here have these 2 Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Flora
scripts.text:
Well hello there.
 
Well this is what I need you to do, bring me 50 Decayed Nails - a while back Payon Cave used to be a safe place to go...But now things have gone out of control and Zombies have invaded the first floor...
 
There is also these new monsters that have just popped out of no were, we call them Flaming Bastards...Be careful if you aren't powerful yet because they are very strong.

scripts.speaker: Flora
scripts.text:
Good Luck
Remember I need 50 Nail's

scripts.speaker: Zed
scripts.text: Get out of my face you flake.

scripts.speaker: Zed
scripts.text:
Dear god took you long enough you bastard!
You know how much my time is worth!!!!
Your slow and I'm never gonna recommend a job for you, Gimmie my staff and get out of me face!

scripts.speaker: Zed
scripts.text: Well you can take this crappy Treasure Token.

scripts.speaker: Zed
scripts.text: Where's my staff?

scripts.speaker: Dassy
scripts.text: Hello!

scripts.speaker: Dassy
scripts.text:
Yes! Now my pet will not starve!
Thank you so much!
Have this Treasure Token.

scripts.speaker: Dassy
scripts.text:
Hello person!!
You have come to help me? Yes, yes.
 
Ok I don't want to talk about it but I need you to fine me 20 Shoot's
Thank you!

scripts.speaker: Czhore
scripts.text:
Hello friend
Have you come to check out one of these guild halls?

scripts.speaker: Czhore
scripts.text:
Thank god!
 
I'm so happy to see one of these Emperiums! Thank you {0}.

scripts.speaker: Czhore
scripts.text:
Here have these 2 Treasure Tokens.
And some of my old treasure...

scripts.speaker: Czhore
scripts.text:
Hello friend
I know this may sound stupid but ever since I was a boy I have dreamed of having an Emperium...
As I know I look old, I have just never been able to find one, now that I am retired from the Treasure Hunter Guild there is no more action for me...
 
If you can get me one I shall reward you.

scripts.speaker: Lithin
scripts.text:
Well hello.
Welcome to the Forest Maze.

scripts.speaker: Lithin
scripts.text: Oh thank you so much, but they will be back...
Take these 2 Treasure Tokens

scripts.speaker: Lithin
scripts.text:
Well hello.
Welcome to the Forest Maze, I have a task for you.
 
Ever heard of a monster called a Savage? It looks like a boar but it makes very annoying noises.
What I want you to do is bring me 15 Manes from the savages.

scripts.speaker: Strange Man
scripts.text: Much thanks I have for you.
Take with you these 2 Treasure Token's.

scripts.speaker: Strange Man
scripts.text:
Must do for me you shall.Venture through the Pyramid.
When second floor you have reached,slay skeletons of evil.
Bring me back there bones you must.
It is 30 that I desire.

scripts.speaker: Blond Girl
scripts.text: I wonder what happened to my flowers

scripts.speaker: Blond Girl
scripts.text:
Oh are these my flower! To bad I don't want them anymore...
 
You can keep them is you want.

scripts.speaker: Blond Girl
scripts.text: Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.

scripts.speaker: Blond Girl
scripts.text: Hello, did you bring me flowers!?!

scripts.speaker: Wizard
scripts.text: Hello, have you seen my Whisper friend?

scripts.speaker: Wizard
scripts.text: Thank you for helping me, I presume the worse.

scripts.speaker: Wizard
scripts.text: Here take these 4 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Wizard
scripts.text:
Hello, the reason why I brought you here was because of a long time ago I made a friend, which happened to be a Whisper.
He told me that he was always bullied by the other ghosts down there and I haven't seen him in a while.
Thinking of the worse case here, I want vengeance!
 
Bring me 50 Fabrics!

scripts.speaker: Thief
scripts.text: Welcome to the Thieves Guild.

scripts.speaker: Thief
scripts.text: Thank you for this delivery.

scripts.speaker: Thief
scripts.text: Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.

scripts.speaker: Thief
scripts.text: Where's my delivery?

scripts.speaker: Strange Man
scripts.text:
Another quest for you I have.
Further into the pyramid you must go.
Fighting Mummies is future for you.
 
Bring back for me their wrappings you must.
It is 30 Rotten bandages I desire.

scripts.speaker: Strange Man
scripts.text: Much thanks for you that I have.

scripts.speaker: Strange Man
scripts.text: Take with you these 3 tokens.

scripts.speaker: Chirach
scripts.text: Welcome.

scripts.speaker: Chirach
scripts.text: Thank you for this delivery.

scripts.speaker: Chirach
scripts.text: Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.

scripts.speaker: Chirach
scripts.text: Where's my delivery?

scripts.speaker: Zuuzuu
scripts.text: Hello, welcome to Geffen tower.

scripts.speaker: Wizard
scripts.text: Thank you for helping me.
Here take these 4 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Zuuzuu
scripts.text:
Oh dear god!!!
One of those evil monsters has followed you up here, Kill it, Kill it!!!

scripts.speaker: Zuuzuu
scripts.text:
Hello, the reason I sent for a young adventurer was because of the problems we are having under the tower.
There seem to be more ghosts day after day down there. What I need you to do is go down there and find these monsters we call Nightmares.
 
You must slay them and bring me 20 of there horse shoes.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: Hello mister {0}.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: Thank you so much!

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: Have these 1 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
Hi mister person. Can you get me some apple juice?
I want 5 of them.

scripts.speaker: Charles
scripts.text: Hello {0} welcome to Alberta.

scripts.speaker: Charles
scripts.text: Thank you for this delivery.

scripts.speaker: Charles
scripts.text: Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.

scripts.speaker: Charles
scripts.text: So where is my package?

scripts.speaker: Sewer Management
scripts.text:
Well there have been reports of a Golden Thief Bug running around the bottom on the Culvert
 
Bring me 1 Gold Bar from him.

scripts.speaker: Sewer Management
scripts.text: Thank you for helping me.

scripts.speaker: Sewer Management
scripts.text: Here take these 4 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet
scripts.text: Sorry, busy.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet
scripts.text: Thank you for helping me, I presume the worse.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet
scripts.text: Here take these 4 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Scarlet
scripts.text:
Good your here. Ok there are reports of an old captain named Drake aborted this ship. Kill Him!
 
Bring me his Saber as proof!

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text:
Hi mister person. Can you get me some Banana juice?
I want 5 of them.

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: Thank you so much!

scripts.speaker: Girl
scripts.text: Have these 1 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.text: Thank you for this delivery.

scripts.speaker: Zack
scripts.text: Thank you for helping me, I presume the worse.

scripts.speaker: Zack

scripts.speaker: Zack
scripts.text:
Hello,the reason why I brought you here was because of a very strange monster known as Baphomet.
People say that Baphomet guilds the gate to the under-world but I don't believe them, Kill Baphomet!
 
Bring me his Evil Horn!

scripts.speaker: Flower
scripts.text: Sorry I'm waiting for someone. You will have to come back later.

scripts.speaker: Flower
scripts.text: Thank you for helping me, I presume the worse.

scripts.text:
Help, help I have lost my Beads!! My brother Bush is going to kill me please help
 
Bring me 10 Glass Beads!

scripts.speaker: Mage
scripts.text: Hello {0} welcome to the Mage Guild.

scripts.speaker: Mage
scripts.text: Thank you for this delivery. Sorry about the smell, Its a box of Toad Tongues

scripts.speaker: Mage
scripts.text: Here take this Treasure Token as a reward.

scripts.speaker: Mage
scripts.text: Hello {0}, Where is my box of Toad Tongues?.

scripts.speaker: School Girl
scripts.text: Sorry I'm waiting for someone, you will have to come back later

scripts.speaker: School Girl
scripts.text: Thank you for helping me.

scripts.speaker: School Girl
scripts.text: Here take these 4 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: School Girl
scripts.text: Help, Well what we know about Payon is that a while ago there was a freak fire that burnt down the old school.

scripts.speaker: School Girl
scripts.text:
The strange thing about what happened was that the children inside did not seem to die from the flames. They have taken over the entire 3rd floor of Payon Cave.
 
Bring me 20 Black Hair!

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text: Sorry I'm waiting for someone, you will have to come back later

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text: Thank you for helping me.

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text: Here take these 4 Treasure Tokens.

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text:
Well I don't know much about this, it has to do with the deepest regions of Payon Cave. We don't know much because no one ever seems to make it back alive. We suspect a monster we call the Moonlight Flower
 
Bring me back 1 Nine Tales!

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text:
Hello, we need you to investigate some crap in the 3rd level of Payon.
 
Bring me back 40 Daenggie's.

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text: Thank you for helping me.

scripts.speaker: Jack
scripts.text: Here take these 3 Treasure Tokens.
